items.title: Louie Bellson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: beside all these great players, there’s a thing called Hansel and Gretel where this little girl goes through this

ctx.x: No. I don’t know about that video.

That didn’t do much, because on it, beside all these great players, there’s a thing called Hansel and Gretel where this little girl goes through this – it has nothing to do with the rest of the album. That’s why it didn’t sell, because they wondered, what’s this little girl doing among all these monsters in here? It was done well, but the connection didn’t work, didn’t jell. It’s called Time Grooves.

We’ll definitely look for it. Actually, when we leave here, we’re going to a record store and get that James Brown. So we’ll look for this one too. You also have Dennis Chambers. He seems to be the youngest of the . . .
